newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan 1997/98 budget day set for June 13.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan 1997/98 budget day set for June 13.

text.p: Pakistani Finance Minister Sartaj Aziz will present the budget for fiscal 1997/98 (July-June) on June 13, one day earlier than expected, a Finance Ministry spokesman said on Friday. He said June 14 had been a tentative date for Aziz's budget speech to the National Assembly (lower house), but Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif had decided to bring it forward by one day.
Sharif is due to travel to Istanbul to attend a June 15 summit meeting of eight Islamic countries that make up the Developing-Eight (D-8) economic cooperation group.
